Then sends multi_item_pickup or multi_item_pickup_stowed_weapon with pickup id and chosen slot. These are clientscript requests; no authoritative inventory result is shown. Uses forced-hint item index unless -1, then first free slot unless -1, then selected index or 0. Returns true only if that inventory item model equals the supplied widget model; otherwise false. Reads controller client number and both client team fields. Returns the literal short-circuit conjunction ending in team equality; missing team fields can return nil rather than Boolean false. Missing target platoon returns false. Otherwise returns false for platoonCount=0 or mismatched controller platoon; true for the remaining path. Controller clientModel:get() is not separately guarded. If same controller team, returns teammateIndex or 0 when falsy. Other teams return -1. Uses TeamPlayerColorNameForClientNum to index ColorSet, then forwards that table to ConvertTableToRGB. Returns the second argument when the third equals 1; otherwise third times first. It does not inspect or move a death circle. Trial sessions localize the special tier-skip key; other sessions localize the supplied key. Reads old mapZoom. Only requested zoom <= MAP_ZOOM_MAX proceeds; there is no lower-bound check. Writes zoom first, derives normalized cursor position from engine bounds on KBM or markerPos otherwise, computes inverse-zoom pan delta, clamps pan to &#91;0,1-1/newZoom&#93;, writes pan and adjusts markerPos for clamp displacement. Division-by-zero and missing model/data values are not repaired. Requests the hashed engine pan operation with controller/x/y before setting the supplied model to {x=x,y=y}. Failure in the first request can prevent the model write. Captures Warzone pan/zoom and source horizontal layout, installs separate pan/zoom callbacks applying the exact horizontal transformation. A scoreboard-open subscription clears DisableZoomIn/Out then reasserts each when its trigger button flag is down. Closing the scoreboard has no reset path in this body. Captures Warzone pan/zoom and source vertical layout. Two subscriptions recompute the displayed row top/bottom positions for pan or zoom delivery using the exact retained expressions; it does not write map state. Computes sqrt(x*x+y*y), divides both supplied table coordinates by it and returns the same table. Zero-length inputs are not guarded. An existing _ignoreInputTimer returns false. Otherwise creates/attaches a timer and returns true; on invocation clears the timer field then sets the supplied model to the captured value. No explicit close call is present in the owned callback. Do not invent the missing reverse-selection call for index 1. With a weaponId and valid nonzero ammoType model value, returns the localized formatted text containing supplied label and ammo type. Otherwise localizes the supplied label alone. Reads hudItems.inventory.selectedItemName under the controller model and injects its get value into localization of the supplied string key. Checks the shared SplitterWidgetElement. If present returns whether its state is Open; absent returns false. The controller argument is unused. Reads objectiveN.unlockProgress from the supplied model. Nonnil/nonnegative progress is injected into the description key; absent/negative progress localizes that key alone. Reads weaponN.hasAttachments from WarzoneInventory and returns equality to numeric 1. Read f383_arg0.weaponId or0. In order, request HeaderWeapon:setText with Engine hash_4F9F1239CFD921FE("WZ/WEAPON_WITH_ID", tostring(id+1)), then HeaderWeaponEquipped:setText with the same provider and literal "WZ/WEAPON_EQUIPED", tostring(id+1). Its close wrapper stops the one-shot sound then requests team_eliminated music; scriptNotify callback plays EndTransition only for post_killcam_transition. Processes menu_loaded, registers class close hook, optionally calls PostLoadFunc, writes ignoreCursor and starts the one-shot sound before returning self. All hooks/subscriptions remain deferred; no respawn/network transaction is proved.

- `hmh07-lua-follow4:133` (original lines 1178-1178, 1182-1182, 1178-1178, 1182-1182, 1178-1178, 1182-1182, 4634-4646, 2286-2302, 2032-2051): Reads the request model and primary controller. FORCE_LOCAL_MODE sets FailedDWConnection and the failedDemonwareConnection global model. RESET_LOADOUTS only for a nonhost first force-notifies closePopups, then PC calls ResetEverythingOnPC; other platforms initialize PlayerSettingsUpdate, open/reset/close the controls overlay on controller 0 and request default offline MP and second hashed storage loadouts using the primary controller. Preserve controller-0 literals and no inferred completion of persistence/VM operations. Creates lobbyRoot.leaderActivity then chooses host text, dedicated-host text, or GetActivityString(event.activity). Sets that model and returns true. Selects game lobby when active, private lobby otherwise. Only a host requests addlobbybot(lobbyType,1,false,0). No bot spawn result is checked. - `hmh07-lua-follow3:234` (original lines not specified): Returns true exactly when the engine currency query for BLACKOPSPASS_INCENTIVE_TOKEN is greater than0; otherwise false. Reads MP online stats and the entitlement-indexed hashed field; returns field==1 when present, nil when buffer/entry is missing. When the MP online stats buffer and entitlement field exist, sets the field to1, requests storagewrite, and returns true. Missing input returns nil. True records the request path, not durable save or server confirmation. Creates the controller EntitlementData model, indexes EntitlementDisplayInfo by the supplied entitlement, and writes entitlement, displayName, description, and addsCODPoints in that order. Missing display metadata is not guarded. First populates popup data, then opens EntitlementPopupEreg for the exact hash_12EDA6DC2D0D4A00 entitlement or EntitlementPopup for all others. The popup target/provider and successful display remain separate. Requests AddToTableIfNotEmpty for every enumerated DOTDImages value. Available baseutility859-863 rejects only the literal hash_0 sentinel; it does not filter empty strings or false keys, and ordinary Lua nil keys can error. It then replaces ForceStreamedEntitlementImages with the ForceStreamHelper result, retaining the old stream helper value as input. Returns true for development build plus the supplied name_force dvar string1, otherwise for positive DOTD incentive-token count plus opaque status query500200==0, otherwise false. No branch is removed merely because it is development-related.

- `hmh07-lua-follow4:222` (original lines 3155-3157, 3169-3172): Builds loot-case, plasma, COD-points and member-name widgets; model callbacks update the displayed values and loot-count helper. ShowPlasma requires Zombies plus valid main mode plus live lobby. A setModel wrapper hides membername only for PC in-game. Registers class close, calls PreLoadFunc at the original late position, optionally replaces COD-points with a fake for PC trial, returns self. Currency values are presentation requests, not grants or purchases.

Lazily maps meansofdeathlist bundle entries into enum-indexed rows, caches even an empty table and returns the table by identity. Compares g_gametype dvar with each ipairs entry of the vararg table; returns true on equal entry and false after iteration. The n field records vararg count but is not used by ipairs. Returns true for absent/falsy roundsplayed or numeric0; otherwise false. Defaults ratio1, divides ammoInClip get() or1 by clipMaxAmmo get() or1 only when both fields exist, then returns ratio,0,0,0. Numeric0 denominator remains truthy and is not guarded/clamped. Requests compass corners/north. Nonzero north-x swaps normalized x/y outputs; else nonzero north-y keeps them aligned. If both north components zero returns nil,nil. Does not guard corner denominators or clamp. Requests corners/north and interpolates world x/y with swapped relative coordinates for nonzero north-x, unswapped for nonzero north-y. Both zero yields nil,nil; no clamp is added. Clamps interpolation amount0..1 then requests component-wise RGB interpolation on the supplied receiver. Saves original clip_over handler then installs a wrapper. On delivered clip_over with no next clip and nondefault state, EnemyKilled decrements a numeric kill counter and either replays DefaultClip or sets DefaultState; other nondefault states reset. Calls originalClipOver last without a nil guard. Sets the nested prematch timer first. False show flag hides numbers and returns; otherwise if start time exists, >5s delay installs faction_start and a one-shot timer, <=5s plays Start immediately. Finally starts the countdown numbers clip. No explicit timer cancellation/close hook appears. Gets predicted client number, concatenates GetClientClantag then GetClientName, and returns it. No separator or nil guard is added. Truthy _allowingButtonRepeats returns without native call; otherwise marks true before the native push request. This is a flag, not a local reference count. Falsy flag returns; otherwise clears it before native pop request. Failure rollback is not provided. Lazily builds the set of written weapon names plus current gameMode suffix, then returns the slot selected by SafeGetModelValue(viewmodelWeaponName). The none/killstreak_remote table is defined but unused; cache is not rebuilt when gameMode changes here. Only existing hints table and truthy indexed entry return the localized entry. Missing paths assign hash0 then fall through without returning it. When abilityHintIndex model/value exists, returns hints-table and #hints==expected. Missing paths assign the none enum then fall through without an explicit return; retain GagdetHintIndex spelling. Returns when Warzone UI is hidden. Requires console, message and primary client; computes names/colors and localized message. Console path writes line fields with reversed-language ordering (missing secondary text is not cleared in the reversed branch), then forces subscriptions. PC path shows a formatted game event using secondary player when present, otherwise primary. No server callout generation or log persistence is proved.
